    index = 1
    results = []

        n = int(data[index])
        a = data[index + 1]

        # Create a list of characters in 'a'
        chars = list(a)
        
        # Sort the characters in reverse order
        chars.sort(reverse=True)
        
        # Join the sorted characters to form the result string
        result = ''.join(chars)
        results.append(result)
